text:
Leila Nassar: hey team — my March paystub looks wrong. I moved to Toronto on 03/10 and updated my profile, but payroll shows both US Social Security and Canadian CPP withheld. can someone check?

Maya (People Ops): sorry to hear that Leila. can you paste the redacted stub lines and the date you updated your residency? we'll pull payroll records.

Leila Nassar: updated residency in self-service on 03/11. stub snippet (redacted):
```
Pay period: 03/01 - 03/15
Earnings: Salary $7,500.00
Deductions:
 - Social Security (FICA) - $465.00
 - Medicare - $108.75
 - Canada Pension Plan (CPP) - $354.60
 - EI - $52.20
Net Pay: $6,519.45
```
I expected CPP/EI only for Canadian payroll, and US FICA should stop after I became Canadian tax resident.

Payroll Bot: Auto: payrun pr-99821 completed. HRIS snapshot indicates residency change event for RED-7729 at ts=1987510000. Payroll adapter payrollify v1.9 shows residence_country updated but tax_residency flag remained "US" due to missing totalization_exemption attribute in import mapping. Earnings records show two tax jurisdiction entries: US_FED/SS and CAN_ONT.

Owen - Payroll: thanks Leila. triage: system relies on tax_residency + totalization_exemption to decide whether to stop US FICA for employees moving to treaty-country. The HRIS update included country but not the treaty flag because our HRIS->payroll sync recently changed the field path from residency_info.country to residency_info.location.country. adapter missed the new path for totalization_exemption. I'll fetch mapping diff.

Rahul (Tax): from a tax perspective, if both employee/employer FICA and CPP/EI are collected for overlapping periods, remediation has two pieces: 1) employee-facing cash correction (refund of duplicate employee FICA if inappropriate) and 2) employer deposit adjustments and possibly amended filings (941-X for the quarter and CRA adjustments for Canadian CPP/EI filings). We also need to document applicability of US-Canada totalization for Leila's exact move date (date of departure and employer obligations).

Maya (People Ops): Leila — would you like payroll to process a corrective off-cycle so you get net refund ASAP while tax coordinates fix?

Leila Nassar: yes please — I need the over-deduction back. Also please confirm whether this will affect my year-to-date taxes and T4/T4A or W-2.

Owen - Payroll: action plan: 1) create off-cycle reversal for employee FICA (employee share SS + Medicare) for the overlapping portion of the payrun; 2) record employer-side reversal entries; 3) flag the payrun for 941-X worksheet. I'll post the draft reversal stub. Payroll Bot indicates transmit step for pr-99821 at ts=1987654000 (tax remittance transmitted). Because the transmit occurred, Finance/Tax will need to coordinate reclaim or file amendments.

Payroll Bot: payrun pr-99821: SUCCESS. Adapter logs: payrollify v1.9 import mapping error: missing path residency_info.location.totalization_exempt -> defaulted to false.

Owen - Payroll: draft off-cycle stub:
```
Reversal: Employee_FICA_reversal -$573.75  (SS $465.00 + Medicare $108.75)
Refund: Off-cycle net refund $573.75
Notes: duplicate FICA withheld post-move to CA->ONT. Audit ref pr-99821 -> pr-99821-rev
```
I'll schedule the off-cycle for tomorrow AM.

Rahul (Tax): I'll own the cross-border filing check. Two immediate items: confirm the effective date for totalization exemption (we need employer records of Leila's permanent move date and any posted travel dates), and compute employer-side reclaim prospect from the US deposit vendor. If reclaim not accepted, we'll prepare 941-X to adjust employer/employee taxes. For Canada, we'll provide CRA with corrected CPP/EI remittance details if necessary.

Leila Nassar: my last US day in office was 03/08, flight left 03/09, and I updated the HRIS on 03/11. employer has my relocation docs in the hr ticket HR-3321. happy to share any paperwork.

Maya (People Ops): thanks Leila — copying HR relocation docs to payroll audit. Owen: please attach HR-3321 to audit ref.

Owen - Payroll: attached. off-cycle job queued pr-99821-rev ts=1987654600. Payroll Bot: queued.

Payroll Bot: off-cycle job pr-99821-rev queued for 1987654600.

Owen - Payroll: executed off-cycle at ts=1987654800. Refund initiated; ledger reversals posted. Payroll Bot: pr-99821-rev: SUCCESS.

Payroll Bot: Notification: corrected payment sent to ACH; bank settlement pending. Audit trail: pr-99821 -> pr-99821-rev, adapter error id MAP-1987.

Rahul (Tax): update: I'm drafting 941-X worksheet and CRA adjustment memo. Vendor response needed for reclaim — Lena (Finance) will coordinate. If we cannot reclaim US deposit, we will document employee refund and file 941-X to report corrected amounts. We will also reconcile employer CPP contributions if our Canadian remittance already included corrected amounts.

Leila Nassar: saw the pending refund in my bank portal, thank you. Do I need to do anything on my Canadian return?

Rahul (Tax): likely no immediate action for you personally — we will provide a summary of corrected wages and withholdings for your records and for any personal filings. If an employer deposit remains in the wrong jurisdiction we will advise on how to claim a refund on the individual's return, but employer-side correction is preferred.

Maya (People Ops): root cause: mapping change in HRIS adapter omitted totalization_exempt path. action items: Owen to patch adapter mapping and add an integration test for residency+totalization flag, Rahul to own 941-X/CRA memo, Finance to attempt reclaim. Leila: closing after you confirm bank clears.

Owen - Payroll: mapping patch submitted (PR#pay-4217) and unit/integration tests added. Scheduling release to prod after post-payroll window.

Payroll Bot: mapping PR pay-4217 added tests for residency_info.location.totalization_exempt.

Leila Nassar: thanks everyone, refund posted to my account. appreciate the quick coordination.

Rahul (Tax): created ticket TAX-2026-57 for 941-X/CRA follow-up with audit refs.

Maya (People Ops): marking thread for closure once TAX-2026-57 updated and bank clears. thanks all :thumbsup:
